issues: All 50 pages are rotated 90° (landscape table scanned on portrait pages); re-rendered with +90° rotation. Page 1 has title/header, page 50 ends with signature/seal; all 50 pages contain table rows. 157 numbered rows. Columns: 1 №, 2 документы/методы, 3 объект, 4 ОКПД2, 5 ТН ВЭД ЕАЭС, 6 показатель, 7 диапазон определения (no separate unit column; unit taken from range text). ОКПД2/ТН ВЭД cells are '-' or blank in all rows, so okpd2_code/tnved_code are always null. tr_section holds the full-width address heading rows ('115088, г. Москва, ул. Угрешская, д. 2, стр. 95, 3 этаж' for rows 1-138; 'стр. 38' for rows 139-157) — these are site headings, not ТР ТС sections. Long ЕАЭС/EP-USP-BP boilerplate in col 2 shortened to identifiers + ' и иные НД ...' in norm_doc; raw_row_text carries the boilerplate reconstructed from its two recurring wordings (minor punctuation variants between rows not preserved). Row 82 norm doc consists only of the EP, USP, BP boilerplate. Row 149 printed as 'ГФ IV' (likely typo for ГФ XIV), kept as printed. Row 151 object cell prints the object list twice; deduplicated. Rows 156/157 share a merged object cell and the 'Специфическая активность' indicator was assigned to row 156, 'Специфичность'/'Подлинность' to 157 (row boundary ambiguous). Many ranges are qualitative ('Соответствует / не соответствует', 'В соответствии с НД производителя', 'Обнаружено/не обнаружено') and put in range_from. Microbiology ranges like 'Отсутствие в г-1x10⁶ КОЕ/г' mapped as range_from='Отсутствие в г', range_to='1x10⁶'. Values '105 КОЕ/г (мл)' in rows 119/123 printed without superscript (likely 10⁵), kept as '105'. Row 83 range '(0-200) % / пересчёт в концентрации/ ...' mapped 0..200 %. Row 71-76 water/ethanol rows expanded to one row per indicator. Typos kept as printed (Термостабильнось, Гиперчувтсвительность, Сенсибиллизирующее, perfringes, кДА).
